name: cortico-world-memo
description: 记忆指路：把一堆 Markdown 笔记切成记忆块、建 IDF 共现边图、按 per-block top-K 做联想召回。只读笔记，索引是可删派生物。
author: 小鲸 & 灯塔 & 321785330caoyun-art

zh.description: 从 Markdown 笔记建记忆图，IDF 加权 + 每块 top-K 邻居，做联想召回。只读笔记，索引可删可重建。

en.description: Builds an IDF-weighted memory graph from Markdown notes with per-block top-K neighbors; associative recall. Read-only, disposable index.
